verification: Task controls and exact Base query/options are native-verified; this flattened PhoneTask combination requires Reader-owned desktop preflight before phone use.

preflight.beforeEnable: Write safe settings while Fileclass and FileClass Inline are disabled; do not overwrite different existing files blindly.
preflight.bases: Enable Bases core. Expect exactly Atlas & Orbit and Borealis research. Hard-fail missing/extra candidates, fallback filename labels, query/view errors or unavailable Bases: Fileclass can fall back to ALL Markdown files.
preflight.entryPoint: Create through FileClass Inline API v2 or native FileClass Inline capture, not Fileclass create-note. Only FileClass Inline promises required-only completion and no optional field insertion.
preflight.phone: Finish syncing settings and every fixture, including the .base file, before enabling Fileclass on iPhone.

files.Classes/PhoneTask.md:
---
icon: link
version: "2.0"
fields:
  - name: summary
    id: phone-summary
    type: Input
    options:
      required: true
    path: ""
  - name: completed
    id: phone-completed
    type: Boolean
    options:
      required: true
    path: ""
  - name: estimate
    id: phone-estimate
    type: Number
    options:
      required: true
    path: ""
  - name: project
    id: phone-project
    type: File
    options:
      required: true
      baseFile: Working/Projects.base
      viewName: Projects only
      displayColumn: note.projectTitle
    path: ""
  - name: details
    id: phone-details
    type: Input
    options: {}
    path: ""
---
# PhoneTask
Four required controls in one form; details is optional and must not appear.
No inheritance, templates, folder/tag bindings, or field defaults.

# FileClass Inline phone test

Use a unique title such as Phone Ada 1 for an inline optional Person capture.

Use Reader's existing capture workflow to create a PhoneTask. Enter summary Phone capture, completed No (false), estimate 0, and project Atlas & Orbit. Save once.

Only the four required fields should appear; details stays absent. Reuse Reader's normal link-opening/Sync check instead of inspecting YAML manually on the phone.
